notes: Identical exported records, grouped by resource, branch and UTC hour; Go compress/gzip for both formats.
Standalone PACs retain full UUIDs and every payload field; routing in PACSource; timestamps verified against UUIDs. Definitions counted once; no external index needed for decoding.
Every PAC member resolved and checked byte-for-byte against its full input frame. PAC compression framing included. JSON uses newline-delimited objects; no pretty-printing.
